description: This is the main command-line interface module for the Universal Project Initializer tool. It handles argument parsing, project configuration creation, template generation, and coordination for initializing various types of software projects. It includes functions to parse parameters, generate configuration objects, translate template info into JSON, and handle commands like retrieving the run command for a specific project type.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object for retrieving template info based on project type and optional parameters.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a base directory.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object to a dictionary with absolute paths for JSON serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and outputs a standardized JSON response indicating success or failure, with optional template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specified project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the process of retrieving the run command for a project type, including exception handling.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point for the CLI application, handling argument parsing, project initialization, and command execution.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
